content_sections.heading: IIT Bhilai Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 2 vacancies are available - 1 for Project Assistant (Technical) and 1 for Project Associate (Technical).

content_sections.heading: IIT Bhilai Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Project Assistant (Technical): A 3-year diploma in CS/ IT plus 2 years of job experience in CS/ IT or BE/ BTech in CS/ IT or MSc in CS/ IT or MCA from a recognized university. Project Associate (Technical): A 3-year diploma in CS/ IT plus 4 years of job experience in CS/ IT or BE/ BTech in CS/ IT plus 2 years of job experience in CS/ IT or MSc in CS/ IT plus 2 years of job experience in CS/ IT or MCA plus 2 years of job experience in CS/ IT.

content_sections.heading: IIT Bhilai Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit for Project Assistant: 35 years Maximum Age Limit for Project Associate: 45 years Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

content_sections.heading: IIT Bhilai Recruitment 2026 - Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Project Assistant (Technical): Rs. 28,000 – 41,000/ - (consolidated) Project Associate (Technical): Rs. 35,000 – 50,000/ - (consolidated)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Bhilai Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 20-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIT Bhilai Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application for the IIT Bhilai Recruitment 2026 is 20th August 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Project Assistant (Technical) posts?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Assistant (Technical) post in the IIT Bhilai Recruitment 2026 drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for Project Assistant (Technical)?
faq.answer: For the Project Assistant (Technical) role, candidates need a 3-year diploma in CS/IT with 2 years of experience, or a BE/BTech in CS/IT, or an MSc in CS/IT, or an MCA from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for Project Associate (Technical) posts?
faq.answer: The consolidated salary for the Project Associate (Technical) position ranges from Rs. 35,000 to Rs. 50,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Project Assistant posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Project Assistant posts is 35 years.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the IIT Bhilai Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications for the IIT Bhilai Recruitment 2026 must be submitted via email. Prepare your application and send it to the official email address specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process for the IIT Bhilai Recruitment 2026 will involve shortlisting of candidates followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q9. Which state is IIT Bhilai located in?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Bhilai (IIT Bhilai) is located in Chhattisgarh, specifically in Durg city.
